user.title: Set up Wochenkorb
user.description: Brochure offers for a postal code and a list of search terms.

data_description.products: Type a term and press Enter to add it, remove it with the cross. Each term creates offer sensors.
data_description.retailers: Empty: all retailers. Otherwise only offers of the selected retailers; you can type your own names.
data_description.mealie_recipes: Needs the Mealie integration. Shows recipes whose main ingredient is on offer.
data_description.shopping_list: Optional. Main ingredients already on this list are marked in the recipe suggestions.

error.products_required: Please enter at least one search term.

menu_options.general: General: postal code, search terms, retailers

general.title: General
general.description: Changes apply at once; sensors of removed search terms are cleaned up.

lists.title: Lists
lists.description: Each list groups search terms and becomes its own tab in the offers card. Its offers are shown there instead of under the retailer.

data_description.name: Shown on the tab, for example Obst.
data_description.terms: These terms are searched even if they are not among the search terms.
data_description.exclude: Offers whose name contains one of these words are hidden (for fruit, for example juice or yoghurt).
data_description.delete: The terms of the list are no longer searched afterwards unless they are among the search terms.
